newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia govt paper mkt value rises to 303 trln rbls.
newsitem.headline: Russia govt paper mkt value rises to 303 trln rbls.

text.p: The market value of Russian government securities rose to 302.52 trillion roubles ($52.18 billion) on July 25 from 300.89 trillion roubles on July 18, the central bank's open-market operations department said on Monday.
The market value of GKO discount Treasury bills rose to 246.52 trillion roubles from 245.77 trillion roubles, it said.
The market value of OFZ interest-bearing bonds rose to 55.99 trillion roubles from 55.12 trillion roubles, it said.
The nominal value of the government paper market edged up to 318.91 trillion roubles from 316.90 trillion roubles. ($ = 5,798 roubles)
